# Link tables API endpoints
{: .no_toc}

Link tables hold a many-to-many relation with its own fields, such as the subjects of a cohort or the interfaces a data acquisition used. Most of them are written through the records they connect; the resources here read and, where allowed, edit the rows directly.

| Resource | App | What it is |
|:---------|:----|:-----------|
| [`cohortsubject`](/api/stem/cohortsubject/) | STEM | Cohort subject records |
| [`collectionsession`](/api/stem/collectionsession/) | STEM | Collection session records |
| [`sessiondatastorage`](/api/stem/sessiondatastorage/) | STEM | Session data storage records |
| [`dataacquisitioninterface`](/api/modules/dataacquisitioninterface/) | Modules | Data acquisition interface records |
| [`episodepersonnel`](/api/modules/episodepersonnel/) | Modules | Episode personnel records |
| [`manipulationinterface`](/api/modules/manipulationinterface/) | Modules | Manipulation interface records |
{% endraw %}
